name: Jax
title: Grandmaster at Arms

passive.name: Relentless Assault

description.normalized: Attacks against champions and minions grant 6% - 20% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. (Max 5 stacks.)

passive.rawParsedText: Attacks against champions and minions grant 6% - 20% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. (Max 5 stacks.)

q.name: Leap Strike

description.normalized: Leaps to a target unit, dealing 70 / 125 / 180 / 235 (+100% AD ) physical damage if it is an enemy.

q.rawParsedText: Leaps to a target unit, dealing 70 / 125 / 180 / 235 (+100% AD ) physical damage if it is an enemy.

w.name: Empower

description.normalized: Empowers the next attack or Leap Strike to deal an additional 55 / 100 / 145 / 190 (+60% AP) magic damage. Deals 175% damage to monsters.

w.rawParsedText:
Empowers the next attack or Leap Strike to deal an additional 55 / 100 / 145 / 190 (+60% AP) magic damage.

Deals 175% damage to monsters.

e.name: Counter Strike

description.normalized: Enters a defensive stance, dodging all incoming attacks and taking 25% reduced damage from champions for 2 seconds. After this duration, nearby enemies are stunned for 1 second and take 35 / 75 / 115 / 155 (+3.5% max target HP + 70% AP) magic damage. Each attack dodged increases this damage by 20% (up to 100%). Re-cast: Ends the defensive stance early to damage and stun nearby enemies immediately.

e.rawParsedText:
Enters a defensive stance, dodging all incoming attacks and taking 25% reduced damage from champions for 2 seconds. After this duration, nearby enemies are stunned for 1 second and take 35 / 75 / 115 / 155 (+3.5% max target HP + 70% AP) magic damage. Each attack dodged increases this damage by 20% (up to 100%).

Re-cast: Ends the defensive stance early to damage and stun nearby enemies immediately.

r.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms

description.normalized: Passive: Deals an additional 75 / 130 / 185 (+70% AP) magic damage with every 3 consecutive attacks he haunches within 3 seconds. Active: Swings his stave, dealing 100 / 200 / 300 (+100% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and gaining Armor and Magic Resist based on the number of champions hit. If he hits a champion, he gains 30 / 50 / 70 (+50% bonus AD) Armor and 18 / 30 / 42 (+30% bonus AD) Magic Resist. If he hits more than one champion, he gains 15 / 20 / 25 (+10% bonus AD) Armor and 9 / 12 / 15 (+6% bonus AD) Magic Resist for 8 seconds per additional champion hit. During this time, his size increases by 10%, and he deals additional magic damage with every 2 attacks instead. Deals 110% damage to monsters.
